paragraphs.text: Moogle is a creature type introduced in Final Fantasy . Moogles are recurring elements in the Final Fantasy franchise , though their depictions vary throughout the series. They are generally small furry bipeds, with protruding ears, small wings, and a colored ball at the end of an antenna on their head (usually called a "pompom").
The expansion symbol for Final Fantasy' s Through the Ages bonus sheet is a moogle's face ( ).
